children: RBC Capital Markets on Thursday launched its coverage of GRAIL
with a Sector Perform rating and an $84 per share target ahead of an FDA Advisory Committee meeting scheduled to discuss the U.S. authorization for its Galleri multi-cancer early detection test.

Analyst Dan Leonard cited concerns over the stock’s valuation as the Molecular and Clinical Genetics Panel of the FDA’s Medical Devices Advisory Committee is set to meet on September 23 to discuss the company’s Premarket

His primary concerns are investments required to achieve meaningful market penetration and the gap between the current reimbursement opportunity and the one needed to reach the total addressable market.

However, the analyst acknowledged that the upcoming AdCom will be an important catalyst for the company, and Galleri will gain recognition from FDA advisors, with a potential approval expected in late 2026/early 2027.

“That said, at the current valuation, we have concerns around the slope of the adoption curve, the depth of cash burn, and the distance between today's reimbursement environment and the one that unlocks the addressable market,” Leonard added.

title: GRAIL rated new Sector Perform at RBC ahead of FDA AdCom on Galleri
